summary: AI/LLM engineer focused on automating product and engineering workflows. I design LLM pipelines, agent-assisted workflows and human-in-the-loop controls, integrate OpenAI-compatible APIs and GigaChat, and build reliable automations with state validation, retry/dedup, observability and CI quality gates. A 4+ year frontend background (React/TypeScript) lets me ship AI features end-to-end: from API and orchestration to the user interface.

bullets: Built hh-ops: an autonomous multi-profile job-search pipeline for vacancy discovery, safe applications and correspondence, with LLM-generated cover letters and employer replies via OpenAI-compatible providers.
Separated deterministic chat-state classification from text generation; human-in-the-loop queue for button/UI-only scenarios so the system never sends duplicate or unsuitable replies.
Reliability machinery for autonomous workflows: state re-checks before writes, stale-state protection, retry/dedup after network errors, fail-closed rules, dry-run/live modes, per-profile locks.
Multi-profile orchestration via cron and bounded workers, automatic cleanup of finished negotiations, privacy-safe operational snapshot reports.
Engineering review loop for AI-assisted development: task decomposition, regression tests, static analysis, CI gates (pytest, Ruff, basedpyright, Shellcheck, Docker, Python 3.11/3.13 matrix).
Designed BrainWave, an education platform with an AI assistant (CS exam prep): GigaChat API, React/Tailwind UI, personalized explanations and automated task checking.
Designed API integrations and stateful automation so the LLM never takes irreversible actions without deterministic guards and a manual escalation path.
Web trading terminal for 10K+ active traders. React 18, TypeScript, WebSocket, IndexedDB, Web Components.
Migrated the support chat from an iframe SDK to a Web Component with a CDN runtime: dialog load 15–20% faster, deploy downtime from ~1 minute to zero.
Designed the WebSocket market-data system (candles, last price, order book) with subscription dedup and auto-reconnect.
B2B/B2C agribusiness platform, 3K+ suppliers. React, TypeScript, Web Workers, Web Locks API.
18K+ item catalog: load time from 3.8s to 0.9s; filtering in a Web Worker: UI latency from 200–400ms down to ~16ms.
AI seed-selection service over 8 agronomic parameters; demand via the platform grew 30%.
